","wasm/qcms_bg.wasm":""}}</script>
<script>'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const fileInput=$('pdfFile'),titleInput=$('bookTitle'),dropZone=$('dropZone'),buildButton=$('buildButton'),exportButton=$('exportButton'),cancelButton=$('cancelButton');
const fileLabel=$('fileLabel'),fileMeta=$('fileMeta'),statusText=$('statusText'),progress=$('progress'),progressWrap=$('progressWrap'),preview=$('preview'),emptyPreview=$('emptyPreview'),summary=$('summary'),chapterRows=$('chapterRows'),chaptersEmpty=$('chaptersEmpty'),addChapterButton=$('addChapterButton');
const template=JSON.parse($('readerTemplate').textContent),bundle=JSON.parse($('pdfBundle').textContent);
let chosenFile=null,converted=null,previewUrl=null,pdfLibraryPromise=null,activeTask=null,revision=0,busy=false,titleTimer=null,passwordReceiver=null;
function bytes64(str){const raw=atob(str);const bytes=new Uint8Array(raw.length);for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)bytes[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);return bytes;}
function moduleURL(base64){return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes64(base64)],{type:'text/javascript'}));}
async function loadPdfLibrary(){
  if(!pdfLibraryPromise)pdfLibraryPromise=(async()=>{
    const libURL=moduleURL(bundle.library),workerURL=moduleURL(bundle.worker);
    const lib=await import(libURL);
    lib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc=workerURL;
    return lib;
  })().catch(error=>{pdfLibraryPromise=null;throw error;});
  return pdfLibraryPromise;
}
class EmbeddedBinaryDataFactory{
  constructor(){}
  async fetch({kind,filename}){
    const folder={cMapUrl:'cmaps',standardFontDataUrl:'standard_fonts',wasmUrl:'wasm'}[kind];
    const data=bundle.assets[folder+'/'+filename];
    if(!data)throw new Error('Ressource PDF intégrée introuvable : '+filename);
    return bytes64(data);
  }
}
function escapeHTML(text){return text.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
function getChapters(maxPage=Infinity){return [...chapterRows.querySelectorAll('.chapter-row')].map(row=>({page:Number(row.querySelector('[data-page]').value),name:row.querySelector('[data-name]').value.trim()})).filter(ch=>ch.name&&Number.isInteger(ch.page)&&ch.page>=1&&ch.page<=maxPage).sort((a,b)=>a.page-b.page);}
function updateChapterCount(){const count=chapterRows.children.length;chaptersEmpty.hidden=count>0;$('chapterCount').textContent=count?count+' chapitre'+(count>1?'s':''):'Facultatif';}
function addChapter(page='',name=''){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='chapter-row';row.innerHTML='<label>Page<input data-page type="number" min="1" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="142" aria-label="Page du chapitre"></label><label>Nom du chapitre<input data-name type="text" maxlength="80" placeholder="Outils" aria-label="Nom du chapitre"></label><button type="button" class="chapter-remove" aria-label="Supprimer le chapitre">×</button>';row.querySelector('[data-page]').value=page;row.querySelector('[data-name]').value=name;row.querySelector('.chapter-remove').onclick=()=>{row.remove();updateChapterCount();if(converted)refreshPreview();};row.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(input=>input.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(converted){clearTimeout(titleTimer);titleTimer=setTimeout(refreshPreview,250);}}));chapterRows.appendChild(row);chaptersEmpty.hidden=true;return row;}
function createBookHTML(data,title=''){const safeTitle=escapeHTML(title),chapters=getChapters(data.pages.length);const values={PDF_HIDDEN:data.sourcePdf?'':'hidden',SOURCE_PDF:JSON.stringify(data.sourcePdf||null).replace(/</g,'\\u003c'),PAGES:JSON.stringify(data.pages).replace(/</g,'\u003c'),CHAPTERS:JSON.stringify(chapters).replace(/</g,'\u003c'),PAGE_COUNT:String(data.pages.length),TITLE:safeTitle,TAB_TITLE:safeTitle||escapeHTML(data.filename.replace(/\.pdf$/i,''))||'Livre',TITLE_HIDDEN:title?'':'hidden',SPREAD_RATIO:String(2*data.ratio),PAGE_RATIO:String(data.ratio)};return template.replace(/__(PDF_HIDDEN|SOURCE_PDF|PAGES|CHAPTERS|PAGE_COUNT|TITLE|TAB_TITLE|TITLE_HIDDEN|SPREAD_RATIO|PAGE_RATIO)__/g,(_match,key)=>values[key]);}
function readPdfBase64(file){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>resolve(String(reader.result).split(',')[1]);reader.onerror=()=>reject(reader.error||new Error('PDF_READ_ERROR'));reader.readAsDataURL(file);});}
function exportFilename(){const raw=titleInput.value.trim()||chosenFile?.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i,'')||'livre';return 'livre-'+(raw.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').slice(0,80)||'export')+'.html';}
function formatSize(bytes){return bytes<1048576?Math.max(1,Math.round(bytes/1024))+' Ko':(bytes/1048576).toLocaleString('fr-FR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+' Mo';}
function status(message,kind='normal'){statusText.textContent=message;statusText.dataset.kind=kind;}
function clearPreview(){converted=null;exportButton.disabled=true;$('openPreviewButton').disabled=true;preview.hidden=true;preview.removeAttribute('src');emptyPreview.hidden=false;summary.textContent='';if(previewUrl){URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);previewUrl=null;}}
function setBusy(value){busy=value;buildButton.disabled=value||!chosenFile;fileInput.disabled=value;titleInput.disabled=value;$('renderQuality').disabled=value;$('includePdf').disabled=value;addChapterButton.disabled=value;chapterRows.querySelectorAll('input,button').forEach(el=>el.disabled=value);cancelButton.hidden=!value;dropZone.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(value));}
function selectFile(file){
  if(busy)return;
  clearPreview();chosenFile=null;fileInput.value='';fileLabel.textContent='Choisir un PDF';fileMeta.textContent='ou le déposer ici';buildButton.disabled=true;
  if(!file)return;
  if(!/\.pdf$/i.test(file.name)&&file.type!=='application/pdf'){status('Choisis un fichier PDF.','error');return;}
  if(!file.size){status('Ce fichier est vide. Choisis un autre PDF.','error');return;}
  chosenFile=file;fileLabel.textContent=file.name;fileMeta.textContent=formatSize(file.size)+' · PDF sélectionné';buildButton.disabled=false;status('PDF sélectionné. Tu peux ajouter un titre ou créer le livre directement.');
}
function refreshPreview(){
  if(!converted)return;
  const html=createBookHTML(converted,titleInput.value.trim());
  const nextURL=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'}));
  const old=previewUrl;previewUrl=nextURL;preview.src=nextURL;preview.hidden=false;emptyPreview.hidden=true;
  if(old)setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(old),1000);
  exportButton.disabled=false;$('openPreviewButton').disabled=false;
  const chapterCount=getChapters(converted.pages.length).length;summary.textContent=converted.pages.length+' page'+(converted.pages.length>1?'s':'')+(chapterCount?' · '+chapterCount+' chapitre'+(chapterCount>1?'s':''):'')+' · export '+formatSize(new Blob([html]).size);
}
function stopPassword(){passwordReceiver=null;const dialog=$('passwordDialog');if(dialog.open)dialog.close();$('password').value='';}
async function cancelJob(){
  revision++;stopPassword();const task=activeTask;activeTask=null;
  if(task)try{await task.destroy();}catch{}
  setBusy(false);progressWrap.hidden=true;status('Création annulée. Tu peux recommencer avec ce PDF.');
}
function showPassword(receiver,reason,lib){
  passwordReceiver=receiver;$('password').value='';$('passwordMessage').textContent=reason===lib.PasswordResponses.INCORRECT_PASSWORD?'Mot de passe incorrect. Réessaie.':'Ce PDF est protégé. Saisis son mot de passe pour le lire.';
  if(!$('passwordDialog').open)$('passwordDialog').showModal();$('password').focus();
}
async function renderPdf(file,onProgress,isCurrent){
  const lib=await loadPdfLibrary();if(!isCurrent())throw new Error('CANCELLED');
  const maxSide=Number($('renderQuality').value)||3600;
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());if(!isCurrent())throw new Error('CANCELLED');
  const loadingTask=lib.getDocument({data:bytes,BinaryDataFactory:EmbeddedBinaryDataFactory,useWorkerFetch:false,cMapUrl:'embedded://cmaps/',cMapPacked:true,standardFontDataUrl:'embedded://standard_fonts/',wasmUrl:'embedded://wasm/',isEvalSupported:false,stopAtErrors:true,canvasMaxAreaInBytes:128*1024*1024});
  activeTask=loadingTask;loadingTask.onPassword=(receiver,reason)=>showPassword(receiver,reason,lib);
  try{
    const pdf=await loadingTask.promise;if(!isCurrent())throw new Error('CANCELLED');
    if(!pdf.numPages)throw new Error('EMPTY_PDF');
    const pages=[];let ratio=1;
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    try{
      for(let i=1;i<=pdf.numPages;i++){
        if(!isCurrent())throw new Error('CANCELLED');onProgress(i,pdf.numPages);
        const page=await pdf.getPage(i),base=page.getViewport({scale:1});
        if(i===1)ratio=base.width/base.height;
        const scale=maxSide/Math.max(base.width,base.height);
        const viewport=page.getViewport({scale});canvas.width=Math.ceil(viewport.width);canvas.height=Math.ceil(viewport.height);
        await page.render({canvas,viewport,background:'rgb(255,255,255)'}).promise;
        if(!isCurrent())throw new Error('CANCELLED');
        const image=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.98);if(!image.startsWith('data:image/jpeg;'))throw new Error('CANVAS_ERROR');
        pages.push(image);page.cleanup();canvas.width=canvas.height=1;
        await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,0));
      }
      return {pages,ratio,filename:file.name};
    }finally{canvas.width=canvas.height=1;}
  }finally{if(activeTask===loadingTask)activeTask=null;await loadingTask.destroy();stopPassword();}
}
$('buildForm').addEventListener('submit',async event=>{
  event.preventDefault();if(!chosenFile||busy)return;
  clearTimeout(titleTimer);clearPreview();const currentRevision=++revision;setBusy(true);progress.value=0;progressWrap.hidden=false;status('Lecture du PDF…');
  try{
    const data=await renderPdf(chosenFile,(i,total)=>{progress.value=Math.round((i-1)/total*100);status('Préparation de la page '+i+' sur '+total+'…');},()=>revision===currentRevision);
    if(revision!==currentRevision)return;
    if($('includePdf').checked){status('Intégration du PDF d’origine…');data.sourcePdf={name:chosenFile.name,base64:await readPdfBase64(chosenFile)};}
    if(revision!==currentRevision)return;
    converted=data;progress.value=100;refreshPreview();status('Livre prêt. Vérifie l’aperçu puis exporte le fichier HTML.','success');
  }catch(error){
    if(revision!==currentRevision)return;clearPreview();
    const messages={EMPTY_PDF:'Ce PDF ne contient aucune page.',CANVAS_ERROR:'Une page n’a pas pu être convertie. Essaie un autre PDF.'};
    status(messages[error.message]||(/InvalidPDF|MissingPDF|FormatError/.test(error.name)?'Ce fichier est illisible ou n’est pas un PDF valide.':'Le PDF n’a pas pu être converti. Essaie un autre fichier dans un navigateur récent.'),'error');
  }finally{if(revision===currentRevision){setBusy(false);progressWrap.hidden=true;}}
});
$('includePdf').addEventListener('change',()=>{if(converted){clearPreview();status('Option modifiée. Crée de nouveau le livre pour l’appliquer.');}});
fileInput.addEventListener('change',()=>selectFile(fileInput.files?.[0]));
for(const event of ['dragenter','dragover'])dropZone.addEventListener(event,e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!busy)dropZone.classList.add('dragging');});
for(const event of ['dragleave','drop'])dropZone.addEventListener(event,e=>{e.preventDefault();dropZone.classList.remove('dragging');});
dropZone.addEventListener('drop',e=>{if(busy)return;const files=e.dataTransfer.files;if(files.length!==1){status('Dépose un seul PDF à la fois.','error');return;}selectFile(files[0]);});
cancelButton.addEventListener('click',cancelJob);
addChapterButton.addEventListener('click',()=>{const row=addChapter();row.querySelector('[data-page]').focus();});
titleInput.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(converted){clearTimeout(titleTimer);titleTimer=setTimeout(refreshPreview,250);}});
$('openPreviewButton').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(converted&&previewUrl&&!busy)window.open(previewUrl,'_blank','noopener');});
exportButton.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!converted||busy)return;
  const html=createBookHTML(converted,titleInput.value.trim());const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'}));
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=exportFilename();document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);
});
$('passwordForm').addEventListener('submit',event=>{event.preventDefault();const receiver=passwordReceiver;if(!receiver)return;const value=$('password').value;if(!value){$('passwordMessage').textContent='Saisis le mot de passe du PDF.';return;}stopPassword();receiver(value);});
$('passwordCancel').addEventListener('click',cancelJob);
$('passwordDialog').addEventListener('cancel',event=>{event.preventDefault();cancelJob();});
</script>
